image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large marine mammal, identified as a grey whale, surfacing in dark water. The image captures the dorsal side of the whale's body, showing dark, mottled skin with lighter patches (likely barnacles or cyamids) and a distinct lack of a dorsal fin, replaced by a series of low humps (knuckles). White sea foam and splashing water obscure the lower boundary where the whale meets the ocean.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head and rostrum are not visible in this frame; the image focuses on the mid-to-posterior dorsal section.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin exhibits the characteristic dark grey/black coloration with irregular lighter/white mottling consistent with barnacle clusters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is clearly no dorsal fin. Instead, a series of small, rounded humps (knuckles) are visible along the ridge of the back, matching the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible curvature of the body suggests a massive, robust volume typical of large cetaceans, though the full spindle shape is cropped.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the Head_and_Face checkpoint; the texture and coloration are clearly visible on the main body mass.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside of the whale and mouth area are completely submerged or out of frame; baleen plates cannot be seen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located on the ventral/lateral sides and are not visible in this dorsal view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail flukes are outside the frame; only the mid-section and rear dorsal knuckles are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface texture appears uneven and rough, consistent with the presence of callosities and barnacles described in the taxonomy.

While some blur is expected due to motion/water, the edge bleeding is slightly unnatural, suggesting minor generative smoothing rather than optical motion blur.

The horizon line or background element in the upper left appears slightly warped or indistinct, lacking clear geometric structure, which is common in AI-generated backgrounds but barely noticeable here.

Verify if the knuckles are structurally plausible. Also, scrutinize the white foam: does it look like generated noise or physically accurate aerated water? Check for 'melting' where the dark skin meets the white foam.
